changelog:
Summary: Major skill refocus from auto video maker to tier list board creation, with new import documentation and template assets.

- Renamed and refocused the skill from "tierlist-video-maker" (video generation) to "tierlist-maker" (interactive board building & import).
- Removed all video generation and script-related files; skill no longer handles narrated video creation or AI vision for image cards.
- Added onboarding templates, sample tierlist markdowns, and expanded technical references for data import and config.
- The skill now guides users step-by-step to create TierVibe tier lists, building the import URL and launching it in the user's browser.
- Updated description and documentation to match the new creation-focused workflow.
